h1: Contact Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction

intro.html: If you’re looking for reliable bespoke carpenter and construction services in Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge or the surrounding areas, we’d love to hear from you. At Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we pride ourselves on offering friendly advice, honest guidance, and a personal service from start to finish.

Our team can help with everything from house extensions, single storey extensions, double storey extensions, wrap around extensions, extension builder, timber framed extensions and garage conversions to bespoke media walls, kitchen fitting and local carpenter services. With over 40 years of combined experience, NVQ qualifications, and a one-year workmanship guarantee, you can be confident your project is in safe hands.
We cover homes across Cambridgeshire and Suffolk, including Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge, and all nearby towns and villages.
Take a moment to explore our gallery for inspiration and read our testimonials to hear what local homeowners say about our work.
